Subject:

M-A101626-01 PUCT hosting Weather Emergency Preparedness and Emergency Operations Plan (EOP) Workshop 12/08/2026

NOTICE DATE:
 October 16, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:
 M-A101626-01 General

SHORT DESCRIPTION: 
PUCT hosting Weather Emergency Preparedness and Emergency Operations Plan (EOP) Workshop 12/08/2026

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
 All Market Participants

DAYS AFFECTED:
 December 8, 2026, 9:00 AM - 12:45 PM

LONG DESCRIPTION:
 The Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) is hosting a workshop on December 8, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 12:45 PM in the Commissioners' Hearing Room located on the seventh floor of the William B. Travis Building, 1701 N. Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701.

The workshop will review the PUCT's findings from its biannual Weather Emergency Preparedness Report and suggested best practices for Emergency Operations Plans (EOPs) to incorporate in the upcoming 2027 annual EOP filings required of electric utilities, transmission and distribution utilities (TDUs), power generation companies (PGCs), municipally owned utilities (MOUs), electric cooperatives, and retail electric providers (REPs).  The workshop agenda also includes:

Texas emergency response overview;

update from the PUCT's Division of Compliance and Enforcement (DICE); and

electric entity spotlight panel discussion.

The target audience of this workshop includes any entities required by 
16 Texas Administrative Code Section 25.53
 to file an EOP.

In-person attendance is encouraged to allow for an opportunity to ask questions.  The meeting will also be broadcast live at: 
https://www.puc.texas.gov/agency/calendar/broadcasts/

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
 The PUCT's Weather Emergency Preparedness Report was filed on September 24, 2026 in PUCT Project No. 53385 and is available on the 
PUCT's Interchange
.

Please refer to PUCT Project No. 53385 for additional filings related to the workshop.

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions, please contact Sherryhan Ghanem, Project Manager in the Public Utility Commission of Texas Infrastructure Division, at 
sherryhan.ghanem@puc.texas.gov
 or (512) 936-7355.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
.
